headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 11, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers edged out the Cleveland Guardians 6-4 in a closely contested matchup, with Chase DeLauter leading the Guardians' offense with 3 hits, including a home run. The Miami Marlins secured a 2-0 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Eury Pérez pitching 7.0 innings of scoreless baseball. The Chicago Cubs secured an 8-6 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Seiya Suzuki leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their team's availability. Los Angeles Dodgers right-handed pitcher Blake Treinen has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. The New York Yankees placed RHP Kervin Castro on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 10, 2026, with right elbow neuritis. The Miami Marlins placed 1B Kyle Stowers on the 10-day injured list retroactive to August 10, 2026, with a left hamstring strain.

The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their lineup by acquiring 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Athletics acquired RHP Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for RF Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded RHP Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for 1B Connor Norby and RHP Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers edged out the Cleveland Guardians 6-4 in a closely contested matchup. Chase DeLauter led the Guardians' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, while Drew Anderson pitched 4 strong innings for the Guardians.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Pirates in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 2-0 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Eury Pérez pitching 7.0 innings of scoreless baseball. Esteury Ruiz led the Marlins' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Nationals 8-6**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured an 8-6 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Seiya Suzuki leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Jacob Webb earned the save, pitching 1.1 innings with 2 strikeouts and no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Mariners 4-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 4-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Randy Arozarena leading the Mariners' offense with a home run and an RBI. Bryan Woo pitched 5 strong innings for the Mariners, striking out 5 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Treinen Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers right-handed pitcher Blake Treinen has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals' roster after being traded in a deal announced on August 5, 2026.
